title: :emoji: What To Do When Windows is No Longer Your Problem :emoji::emoji:
content: Thinking about ditching Windows but not sure what comes after installing something new? MetaFilter member demi-octopus has written a guide to throwing Windows out the, um, window and installing Linux Mint. Over three posts, the why, how, and now what questions are covered to get you off that proprietary OS (NO MORE TEAMS) and into something new!
author: Brandon Blatcher
